set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem pow_mod_three_period_two (b n : ℕ) (hb : b % 3 = 2) : Nat.ModEq 3 (b ^ (n + 2)) (b ^ n) := by
  have h₁ : b % 3 = 2 := hb
  have h₂ : ∀ k : ℕ, b ^ k % 3 = (2 ^ k) % 3 := by
    intro k
    have h₃ : b % 3 = 2 := h₁
    have h₄ : b ≡ 2 [MOD 3] := by
      rw [Nat.ModEq]
      <;> simp [h₃, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
    have h₅ : b ^ k ≡ 2 ^ k [MOD 3] := by
      calc
        b ^ k ≡ 2 ^ k [MOD 3] := by
          simpa [Nat.ModEq] using h₄.pow k
        _ = 2 ^ k := by rfl
    rw [← Nat.mod_add_div (b ^ k) 3, ← Nat.mod_add_div (2 ^ k) 3]
    simp [Nat.ModEq, Nat.pow_mod, h₁] at h₅ ⊢
    <;> ring_nf at h₅ ⊢ <;> omega
  have h₃ : b ^ (n + 2) % 3 = (b ^ n) % 3 := by
    have h₄ : b ^ (n + 2) % 3 = (2 ^ (n + 2)) % 3 := by
      rw [h₂]
      <;> simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod]
    have h₅ : b ^ n % 3 = (2 ^ n) % 3 := by
      rw [h₂]
      <;> simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod]
    have h₆ : (2 ^ (n + 2)) % 3 = (2 ^ n * 4) % 3 := by
      calc
        (2 ^ (n + 2)) % 3 = (2 ^ (n + 2)) % 3 := rfl
        _ = (2 ^ n * 4) % 3 := by
          rw [show 2 ^ (n + 2) = 2 ^ n * 4 by
            calc
              2 ^ (n + 2) = 2 ^ n * 2 ^ 2 := by ring_nf
              _ = 2 ^ n * 4 := by norm_num]
          <;> simp [Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod]
    have h₇ : (2 ^ n * 4) % 3 = (2 ^ n) % 3 := by
      have h₈ : 4 % 3 = 1 := by norm_num
      have h₉ : (2 ^ n * 4) % 3 = ((2 ^ n) % 3 * (4 % 3)) % 3 := by
        simp [Nat.mul_mod]
      rw [h₉, h₈]
      <;> cases n <;> simp [pow_add, pow_one, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod] at *
      <;> norm_num at * <;> omega
    have h₈ : (2 ^ n * 4) % 3 = (2 ^ n) % 3 := by rw [h₇]
    have h₉ : (2 ^ (n + 2)) % 3 = (2 ^ n) % 3 := by
      omega
    omega
  have h₄ : b ^ (n + 2) ≡ b ^ n [MOD 3] := by
    rw [Nat.ModEq]
    <;> simp [h₃, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
    <;> omega
  exact h₄

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem pow_mod_three_period_two (b n : ℕ) (hb : b % 3 = 2) : Nat.ModEq 3 (b ^ (n + 2)) (b ^ n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      change b ^ (0 + 2) % 3 = b ^ 0 % 3
      norm_num [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod, hb]
  | succ n ih =>
      change b ^ (Nat.succ n + 2) % 3 = b ^ Nat.succ n % 3
      change b ^ (n + 2) % 3 = b ^ n % 3 at ih
      have hp : b ^ (Nat.succ n + 2) = b ^ (n + 2) * b := by
        have h : Nat.succ n + 2 = (n + 2) + 1 := by
          omega
        simpa [h] using (pow_add b (n + 2) 1)
      calc
        b ^ (Nat.succ n + 2) % 3 = (b ^ (n + 2) * b) % 3 := by
          rw [hp]
        _ = ((b ^ (n + 2) % 3) * (b % 3)) % 3 := by
          exact Nat.mul_mod (b ^ (n + 2)) b 3
        _ = ((b ^ n % 3) * (b % 3)) % 3 := by
          rw [ih]
        _ = (b ^ n * b) % 3 := by
          symm
          exact Nat.mul_mod (b ^ n) b 3
        _ = b ^ Nat.succ n % 3 := by
          simp [Nat.pow_succ]
